name: Boundless Fist
description: Throw a fist whose weight has no limit that the user can feel and lands as if it had none.

name: Boundless Brace
description: Stand with a frame that has no edge to break so blows pass into it and are lost.

name: Boundless Vigor
description: Share the frame's limitless strength with an ally so its limbs bear a far greater weight.

name: Boundless Hold
description: Hold the target in a grip no struggle can strain and no strength can break.

name: Limitless Hammer
description: Bring a hammer of unmeasured weight down through the target's guard and frame.

name: Limitless Press
description: Press the target beneath a weight so vast it cannot rise or strike or speak.

name: Limitless Sweep
description: Sweep a limitless weight round the user and strike every target within its great reach.

name: Limitless Renewal
description: Let the frame's unbounded strength knit the user's own torn muscle and cracked bone quickly closed.

name: Infinite Reckoning
description: The school's final tally in which a weight without end is brought to bear on a single target.

name: Infinite Judgment
description: The school's great verdict in which the unbound frame passes sentence on the whole front.

name: Boundless Ruin
description: Drive the whole unbounded mass into the front; its ruin reaches the destructive ceiling of a Core-tier cultivator.

name: Matched Weight
description: The user's body takes on exactly the weight of whatever it strikes and no qi mechanic explains this.

name: Final Fist
description: Throw a fist that carries every weight the user has borne in a single blow.

name: Final Brace
description: Stand in the last stance of the titan against which no force is great enough.

name: Final Vigor
description: Pass the last titan's strength to an ally so that it stands undiminished through the longest war.

name: Final Seizure
description: Take the target in a hold from which no fighter of its tier can free itself.

name: Last Hammer
description: Drop the last titan's hammer through guard and frame and the ground beneath the target.

name: Last Embrace
description: Close the titan's arms about the target and bear down until it ceases to struggle.

name: Last Sweep
description: Sweep the whole titan's reach across the front and strike each target it passes.

name: Last Renewal
description: Pour the titan's endurance into the user or an ally and close its wounds with returning strength.

name: Eternal Verdict
description: The school's final stroke in which the last titan passes a verdict that no strength can appeal.

name: Eternal Decree
description: The school's decree in which the last titan lays its weight on a single will and holds it down.

name: Eternal Burden
description: The school's great stroke in which the last titan sets down the burden of ages upon the front.

name: Last Cataclysm
description: Bring the titan's last weight down on the front; its ruin reaches the destructive ceiling of a Divine-tier cultivator.

name: Eternal Collapse
description: Drop an age of weight upon one target; the blow reaches the destructive ceiling of its tier and nothing stands.

name: Weight Reversed
description: Turn the fall of weight itself about for all within reach so that they rise and drop upward and no qi mechanic explains this.

name: Last Burden
description: Lay the whole weight of all that the user has borne upon one target at once and no qi mechanic explains this.
